classification.analysis: AI Thing is a privacy-first, BYOK desktop AI automation app for macOS (Swift/AppKit) with a companion Tauri-based cross-platform shell, letting users run frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) and connect agents like Google Workspace, GitHub, and Notion via MCP servers. It supports background automations, multi-model switching within a single conversation, and complex multi-app tasks, all with local storage of conversations and API keys instead of a hosted backend. It targets individuals who want a self-hosted alternative to paid agent platforms and is now fully open source. Notable tech: Swift/SwiftUI native macOS app, Firebase auth, Tauri/Rust shell, MCP client integration.

use_cases.title: Run background AI automations that span multiple apps and tools
Use your own Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini API keys in a local-first chat client
Connect an AI agent to GitHub, Google Workspace, and Notion via MCP
Switch between multiple frontier models mid-conversation on desktop
